sections.title: Any control fits in a section
sections.text: Sections take any UI5 control, not only text. This one holds a rating and an action.

sections.title: Appearance
sections.text: Uses the active UI5 theme and adapts to every supported variant.

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.text: Each header is a button that reports whether its section is expanded, and the section is a region named by that header.
